# <ticket id> — <precise technical title>

**Audience:** engineers. **Status:** fixed in <commit/branch> · **Severity:** <S1–S4>

## Summary

Three sentences: what broke, why, what we changed.

## Impact

Who was affected, since when, and how we know (logs, queries, reports).
Say plainly what we do *not* know.

## Root cause

The chain of events, from the code that was wrong to the symptom the user
saw. Include the line(s) and, where it helps, a minimal snippet.

## Why it was not caught

The missing test, the misleading name, the assumption that did not hold.
Blameless: describe the system, not the person.

## The fix

What changed and why this change rather than the alternatives you
considered (list them in one line each).

## Verification

Tests added, manual checks performed, data checked after deploy.

## Follow-ups

| Action | Owner | Ticket |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## References

Links to documentation, issues and articles used, one line each on why.
